warnings.subject: ps-s1
warnings.text: Angel S's 260,416 Seed Preferred, from its SAFE, were issued at $0.96 a share but carry Seed Preferred's $1.20 preference. A SAFE's shares often go into a series of their own, with a preference at the price they converted at. If these did, record that series in the round.

warnings.subject: seed
warnings.text: Seed Preferred's conversion price is recorded as falling from $1.20 to $1.00 in this round, but Seed Preferred has no anti-dilution recorded. A conversion price usually changes in a round only under the series' anti-dilution. If its charter gives it some, record it.
